info.name: Total Expert Public Account Endpoints Email APIs API

items.docs:
Retrieves archived email content using the encoded messageId format: id-{organizationId}-{messageId}.

The organization ID embedded in the messageId is validated against the authenticated caller's organization. A mismatch returns 404 — not 403 — to avoid leaking whether a message exists.

Path parameter: id-{orgId}-{msgId} — replace 42 with the org ID and 9001 with the message ID.

Required filter: user_id={userId} — the user must belong to the caller's org.

Retrieves archived email content using a plain numeric messageId.

The organization is inferred from the authenticated caller's token — no org ID is embedded in the messageId. The caller's org is validated against the message sender's org inside the DataManager.

Path parameter: plain integer string — replace 9001 with the message ID.

Required filter: user_id={userId} — the user must belong to the caller's org.

info.name: Email Template Render - By template ID

items.docs:
Renders a saved email template by its id with placeholders resolved for the given sender, recipient, and optional context.

The template must belong to the caller's organization and be accessible to the sender.

Required: id, sender_id

Optional: recipient, loan_id, account_id, comarketer_id, odc_push_result_id, video, content.subject (overrides template subject)

Alternate documented request: Email Template Render - By inline HTML.

Uploads a user image as raw binary in the request body.

The image is stored in S3 under the target user's marketing images path and a record is created in the database.

Headers required:

Content-Type — MIME type of the image (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif)

X-User-Id — TE user ID of the target user. Must belong to the same org as the caller.

Body: raw binary bytes of the image file. Max 5 MB.
